1351
# A first sync's cost as the tree grows had no test on main. Each block below guards one fix commit and fails without it.
# core/driver/src/folder/tests/sync_transfers_and_retries.rs and folder/ahead.rs: uploads ahead of a commit (receipt reuse, a refused receipt, a failed upload, a crash with a commit and an upload ahead out, a file that changes after its upload ahead).
# core/driver/src/observe.rs: one open per folder and file per observation, including a folder renamed, replaced by a symbolic link or moved out of the root between two reads.
# core/engine/src/commit.rs and core/engine/tests/first_upload.rs: a first-link commit reads as many entries whatever the tree's size, and the next commit's files are upcoming while one is out.
# core/fs/src/entries.rs and core/fs/tests/mark.rs: the mount index follows every write to the entries, and a batch of marks marks each entry a single mark would.
# core/driver/src/engine.rs: a batch that lists the rules files the trees hold plans nothing again (42 lines).
# core/fs/src/mark.rs: a mark recorded while a scan carries the marks before it is kept (42 lines, with its cfg(test) hook).
# core/driver/tests/first_sync_bench.rs and tests/common/mod.rs: the two-million-entry stall gate and the per-entry heap gate, which share the Worker claim helpers moved out of tests/sync.rs.
# core/driver/src/folder/tests/ignored_entries_and_moves.rs: the outstanding folders match a rebuild after a folder leaves a removed one and a file below it moves into an ignored folder.
# core/driver/src/folder/tests/moves_and_name_collisions.rs and observe.rs: a file opened after its folder left the root never reaches the server, and no read through a folder that left its path carries content (with its cfg(test) hook).
# core/driver/src/folder/tests/sync_transfers_and_retries.rs: an upload ahead of chunks the server holds is not started again, and a LogTruncated or AheadOfServer resync while a commit waits for its uploads ahead still sends it.
# core/driver/tests/first_sync_bench.rs: the stall gate and the whole-tree check judged on fake status traces.
